author: Chris Schommer
title: Trevor McDonald labors early in loss to Marlins
desc: Trevor McDonald allowed five (three earned) runs on three hits and three walks while striking out one over three innings in Saturday's loss to the Marlins.
impact: McDonald has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in four of his last six contests. The right-hander remains another inconsistent arm in the Giants rotation for manager Tony Vitello, posting a 4.93 ERA and 1.34 WHIP with a 2-5 record and 8.3 K/9 ratio through nine starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Harrison sharp again in loss to Braves
desc: Kyle Harrison allowed two earned runs on four hits while striking out seven over 6 1/3 innings in Saturday's loss to the Braves.
impact: Harrison continues an impressive stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in 13 of 14 trips to the mound. The left-hander remains another elite starting option alongside Jacob Misiorowski at the top of the Brewers rotation for manager Pat Murphy, carrying a 2.50 ERA and 1.06 WHIP with an 8-1 record and 10.9 K/9 ratio across 14 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Cooper Pratt steals base in loss to Braves
desc: Cooper Pratt went 2-for-4 in Saturday's 4-3 loss to the Braves with one run scored and one stolen base.
impact: Pratt continues a steady stretch at the plate since being called up, recording hits in each of his last four contests. The 21-year-old offers manager Pat Murphy another impactful option in the Brewers lineup, batting .375 with two RBI, two runs scored, and three stolen bases through five games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Spencer Arrighetti shelled in loss to Guardians
desc: Spencer Arrighetti allowed six earned runs on six hits while striking out eight over six innings in Saturday's loss to the Guardians.
impact: Arrighetti has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in each of his last four starts. The right-hander remains one of the more steady options as part of an underperforming Astros rotation, posting a 3.13 ERA and 1.20 WHIP with a 7-3 record and 8.9 K/9 ratio through 12 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: J.T. Ginn fights command in loss to Angels
desc: J.T. Ginn allowed four earned runs on seven hits and three walks while striking out five over 5 1/3 innings in Saturday's loss to the Angels.
impact: Ginn has offered mixed results on the mound of late, allowing four earned runs or more in two of his last four trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of the more reliable options as part of an inconsistent Athletics rotation, posting a 3.16 ERA and 1.21 WHIP with a 5-4 record and 8.0 K/9 ratio across 17 appearances.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Owen Caissie logs stolen base Saturday
desc: Owen Caissie went 1-for-2 with two walks, one run scored, one RBI and a stolen base in Saturday's 6-3 win over the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Owen Caissie did not homer for a third straight game on Saturday, but still contributed by scoring in his third consecutive contest and adding a stolen base. He is hitting .184/.283/.474 in June, though he has caught fire recently, going 5-for-10 over his last three games with two home runs, two walks, two runs scored and five RBI.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Esteury Ruiz steals base Saturday
desc: Esteury Ruiz went 0-for-2 but reached base via a hit-by-pitch, scored a run and added a stolen base in Saturday's 6-3 win over the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Ruiz took advantage of his only time reaching base in the fourth inning, stealing second and advancing to third on a throwing error by catcher Eric Haase before scoring on a Jakob Marsee RBI single. He has started three of the past five games and is batting .385/.543/.769 with six stolen bases across 26 at-bats in June, though his role could diminish once Griffin Conine returns from a hamstring injury.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Otto Lopez swipes bag in win Saturday
desc: Otto Lopez went 1-for-5 with two runs scored and a stolen base in Saturday's 6-3 win over the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Lopez has now logged stolen bases in back-to-back games and has five steals in June. He's been one of the top fantasy shortstops this season, slashing .332/.364/.465 with 15 stolen bases across 76 games.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Heriberto Hernandez launches homer Saturday
desc: Heriberto Hernandez went 1-for-3 with a home run, a walk, one run scored and two RBI in Saturday's 6-3 win over the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Hernandez launched a 389-foot, two-run homer off left-hander Matt Gage in the fourth inning, with the ball leaving his bat at 107.2 mph. He has recorded a hit in six of his last seven games and is slashing an impressive .294/.333/.627 across 51 at-bats in June. Hernandez should continue to see regular playing time while Griffin Conine (hamstring) remains sidelined.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Pete Fairbanks notches save Saturday
desc: Pete Fairbanks allowed no runs or hits while striking out two batters in the ninth inning to pick up the save in Saturday's 6-3 win over the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Fairbanks has not allowed a hit or a run in back-to-back appearances while converting a save in each outing. After a rough start to the season, he appears to have turned the corner, posting a 3.52 ERA and 1.17 WHIP with 10 strikeouts across 7.2 innings while going a perfect 5-for-5 in save opportunities. He's worth adding in fantasy leagues if in need of saves.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Max Meyer records seven punchouts in win Saturday
desc: Max Meyer allowed two runs on seven hits and two walks while striking out seven across five innings in Saturday's 6-3 win over the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Meyer surrendered an RBI single in the second inning and a solo home run to Casey Schmitt in the fourth, but he was sharp otherwise. He has recorded at least seven strikeouts in three of his last four starts and owns an impressive 2.31 ERA with 28 strikeouts across 23.1 innings during that stretch.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Taylor Walls swipes two bags in loss Saturday
desc: Taylor Walls went 1-for-2 with a double, two walks, one run scored and two stolen bases in Saturday's 4-3 loss to the Washington Nationals.
impact: Walls continues to be a threat on the basepaths, swiping six bases in June and 12 on the season. While he doesn't offer much power, he's getting on base at a solid clip, posting a .349 OBP this month, and is taking advantage with his speed. He's worth considering in deeper fantasy leagues for managers in need of stolen bases.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Chandler Simpson chips in two hits and a steal in loss Saturday
desc: Chandler Simpson went 2-for-4 with one RBI and one stolen base in Saturday's 4-3 loss to the Washington Nationals.
impact: Simpson recorded his first multi-hit game and first stolen base of the month. He has struggled mightily in June, posting a .140/.178/.140 slash line, but he's gone 3-for-8 over his last two games, offering a potential sign that he's beginning to break out of his slump.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Junior Caminero racks up three hits in loss Saturday
desc: Junior Caminero went 3-for-3 with three singles, a walk, one run scored and one RBI in Saturday's 4-3 loss to the Washington Nationals.
impact: Caminero had an outstanding day, reaching base safely four times while also driving in a run with a sacrifice fly. He has now reached base safely in 11 consecutive games and is slashing .302/.384/.460 across 63 at-bats in June.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ian Seymour gives up three runs Saturday
desc: Ian Seymour allowed three earned runs on seven hits and no walks while striking out four over five innings in Saturday's 4-3 loss to the Washington Nationals.
impact: Seymour made his third start of the season and stretched out to a season-high 81 pitches. He turned in a solid performance, striking out four while allowing three runs. Through three starts, he owns a 4.09 ERA and 1.00 WHIP, and he's scheduled to make his next start on Thursday against the Kansas City Royals.
